labels_everything_else_keeps.name: labels_everything_else_keeps
labels_everything_else_keeps.value: "labels"."id" <> 'everything_else' OR ("labels"."disposition" = 'keep' AND NOT "labels"."block" AND NOT "labels"."digest" AND NOT "labels"."mark_read" AND NOT "labels"."unsubscribe")

rules_says_something.name: rules_says_something
rules_says_something.value: "rules"."label_id" IS NOT NULL OR "rules"."when_label" IS NOT NULL OR "rules"."disposition" IS NOT NULL

rules_condition_needs_label.name: rules_condition_needs_label
rules_condition_needs_label.value: "rules"."condition" IS NULL OR "rules"."label_id" IS NOT NULL
